propositions: gerrit-verify.yaml's build-and-test job hand-copies the gate+suite command set from test.yml, creating drift risk enforced only by a guard test that must be maintained
A single reusable workflow (_build-and-test.yml) parameterized by gerrit-refspec should eliminate the duplication by serving both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml as the single source of truth
The reusable must define three jobs (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) with conditional checkout logic matching _optionality.yml's pattern, take no secrets, and preserve all current gate commands

Five independent safety invariants in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must be preserved and retargeted: gate-exists + delegation check, script-gate drift scan, pre-commit SKIP verification, redundant-hook SKIP verification, and optionality contract check

Both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must delegate to the reusable workflow, with gerrit-verify's reusable-call job named build-and-test and included in vote's needs list to preserve end-to-end Verified voting
